definitions.explanation: The elected head of a Japanese prefecture (県), responsible for governing prefectural affairs. Japan has 43 prefectures designated as 県, each headed by a 県知事.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{県知事|けんちじ}が{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: A new prefectural governor was elected.

examples.japanese: {県知事|けんちじ}が{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: The prefectural governor held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {県知事|けんちじ}{選挙|せんきょ}は{来月|らいげつ}に{行|おこな}われる{予定|よてい}で、{三人|さんにん}の{候補者|こうほしゃ}が{立候補|りっこうほ}している。
examples.english: The gubernatorial election is scheduled for next month, with three candidates running.

notes:
The governor of a Japanese prefecture ({県|けん}). Japan has 47 prefectures, of which 43 are {県|けん}. The remaining four use different designations: {都|と} (Tokyo), {道|どう} (Hokkaido), and {府|ふ} (Osaka and Kyoto). Their governors are called {都知事|とちじ}, {道知事|どうちじ}, and {府知事|ふちじ} respectively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県知事|けんちじ}{選挙|せんきょ}: gubernatorial election
- {県知事|けんちじ}を{務|つと}める: to serve as prefectural governor
- {現|げん}{県知事|けんちじ}: the current prefectural governor

RELATED WORDS:
- {知事|ちじ} — governor (general term for any prefectural-level governor)
- {都知事|とちじ} — governor of Tokyo
- {市長|しちょう} — city mayor
- {首長|しゅちょう} — head of a local government (general term)
